-- Boot Rayfield
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

-- Create Window
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "+1 speed per step",
    LoadingTitle = "Auto GUI Loading",
    LoadingSubtitle = "blabalbal",
    ShowText = "Rayfield",
    Theme = "Default",
    ToggleUIKeybind = "K"
})

-- Create Tab
local Tab = Window:CreateTab("Automation", "rewind")

-- ================= Auto Treadmill =================
local treadmillRemote = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
    :WaitForChild("Remotes")
    :WaitForChild("Level")
    :WaitForChild("Treadmilling")

local treadmillToggle = false

Tab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Auto Treadmill",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "AutoTreadmill",
    Callback = function(Value)
        treadmillToggle = Value
        spawn(function()
            while treadmillToggle do
                treadmillRemote:FireServer(true, 0)
                task.wait(1) -- time spent treadmilling
                treadmillRemote:FireServer(false)
            end
        end)
    end
})
